content:
Rosa Mendes: Hi everyone, excited to join Redwood! Im Rosa (platform QA), remote from Lisbon. Tiny setup snag: I got the MDM invite but the device enrollment page throws a 403. Also where do I sign up for a hardware stipend and is there a preferred courier for shipping a laptop to EU? Fun fact: I collect vintage map pins from every city I visit :round_pushpin:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome, Rosa! 389 Please confirm the invite link and attach the invite token to the IT ticket if the page returns 403. Stipend info: https://redwood.internal/people/stipend. For EU shipping we usually use our EMEA partner courier (choose "Redwood Logistics" during the form). If youd like, reply here and we can open a ticket on your behalf.
Ibrahim Khan: welcome Rosa! Im on the infra team — the 403 usually means the invite was generated with a different email. Can you DM me the invite token (it looks like `INV-xxxx`)? Ill check the enrollment logs. Also +1 on the stipend, HR tends to approve within 48h for EU.
Lena Park: hey Rosa :wave: Im your onboarding buddy. I can help arrange an EU-friendly pickup if you prefer not to ship. Also our onboarding doc has a checklist for remote setups: Confluence -> People Ops -> Remote Onboarding. Ill add you to #qa and #emEA-office channels.
Office-Facilities: Hi Rosa, facilities here. We can ship via Redwood Logistics or hold a handoff at partner hubs in Lisbon. Please fill the hardware request form and select "EMEA courier" and include the preferred delivery window.
Rosa Mendes: thanks all 60a Ive DMd Ibrahim the token. I filled the stipend form and selected "Redwood Logistics" for shipping. Appreciate the quick responses — will post a picture of my map pin collection when Im settled :camera_with_flash:
Onboarding-Bot: IT ticket #IT-9058 created for MDM 403 error. Facilities ticket #FAC-5012 created for EU laptop shipment. Youll get updates here.
Ibrahim Khan: saw the token, looks like the invite was issued to an alias. Reissued invite to your primary email 44d should be good to enroll in ~5min.
Lena Park: also FYI we usually do a "welcome sync" for remote new hires on Friday 10:30am PT — Ill send a calendar invite. Feel free to bring a show-and-tell (map pins encouraged).
Rosa Mendes: perfect, thanks everyone! See you Friday :grinning_face_with_big_eyes:
